Poller "{{ .Values.poller.name }}" (id {{ .Values.poller.id }}) deployed as StatefulSet {{ include "centreon-poller.fullname" . }}.

gorgone connects to {{ ternary "wss" "ws" .Values.central.ssl }}://{{ .Values.central.host }}:{{ .Values.central.port }}{{ trimSuffix "/" .Values.central.baseUri }}/gorgone/pullwss/websocket
  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} logs {{ include "centreon-poller.fullname" . }}-0 -c gorgone

centengine crash-loops until the central exports its configuration:
  1. Export the poller configuration from the central (generate + move + restart).
  2. Check the poller's broker output host and "Cache directory"
     ({{ .Values.engine.cbmodCacheDirectory }}) in Centreon, then restart the
     engine once (a reload does not switch cbmod's cache directory).
